findings.evidence: `Boundary.lean:166-168` proves `inl_capMatching`, and `Boundary.lean:198-200` proves `inr_cupMatching`; both identify exactly the far endpoint of the relevant cap/cup.
findings.fix: Prove both helpers from those matching lemmas (using the subtype points `⟨a, h⟩`) instead of case-splitting `D.val`, or use the matching lemmas directly at their consumers.
findings.issue: `val_inl_eq_inl_middlePoint` and its cup analogue at line 151 re-derive the endpoint facts already exposed by `BrauerDiagram.inl_capMatching` and `BrauerDiagram.inr_cupMatching`.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Logic/Relation.lean:755` defines `ReflTransGen.swap`; the new specialized theorem is used only once, at `LoopCount.lean:287`.
findings.fix: Replace the induction with `h.swap.mono (fun _ _ hab => hab.symm)` using `Relation.ReflTransGen.swap` and `MiddleAdj.symm`; remove the specialized theorem if its sole consumer can use this directly.
findings.issue: `MiddleAdj.reflTransGen_symm` manually re-proves reversal of a reflexive-transitive path, although Mathlib provides the generic reversal operation.

summary: The loop-count construction is new, but several supporting proofs re-derive existing Boundary and Mathlib relation APIs.
